## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `bca6ac58cf6ee6f005f41f280fd34ba4945c7576`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration (both changesets carry `Clause-②: no`; no published schema, no governed path: `check-governed-merges --pr 34091` 0 of 10 paths). This record is also the same-head confirmation the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class of `check-empty-changeset` asks for, because the diff changes code. Inputs read: card #33980, the Claim and its amendment, the os-dev report, PR #34091 body, the net diff against `main` at the merge base (10 files), and the check-runs on this head (2026-11-15T20:27Z: 56 `success`, 9 `skipped`, 1 `failure` = `Check Changeset`, the designed red below).

### ① Derived judgments

- Behaviour: both copies of the Radix focus-scope patch (root `patches/` and `ui/patches/`, byte-identical) add one early return to `handleMutations`: when focus sits on `body` and the last element the scope saw focused is still inside the container, a removed node is not read as focus lost. Focus is pulled back to the container only when the last focused element really is gone, which is what the trap exists for. `pnpm-lock.yaml` moves only the patch hash.
- Consumer: `ImportWizard.tsx` drops its local `createPortal` workaround; the "Save current" reason tooltip renders inline again. The sr-only description span is unchanged, so the reason is still read with the tooltip closed.
- Public surface: no export moves in `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/console` or `@objectstack/console`. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.
- Pins: `dialog-popover-focus-scope.test.tsx` (unit), `manage-views-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts` (new e2e) and the updated `import-wizard-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts` header; `Build & E2E UI` and the `Test UI` shards concluded `success` on this head.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/33980-focus-trap-blur-unmount.md`: `patch` on `@object-ui/console`, `@objectstack/console`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `Clause-②: no`. Correct: a fix with no surface change.

DELIBERATE CORRECTION of the pending note `.changeset/33862-import-wizard-save-reason-tab-trap.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch, unreleased), judged sentence by sentence. One sentence changes, the last:

- Before: "The tooltip now renders outside the dialog, so Tab and Shift+Tab walk every control in order and the reason is still read out when the wrapper is focused."
- After: "The dialog's focus trap no longer reads that removal as focus lost, so Tab and Shift+Tab walk every control in order and the reason is still read out when the wrapper is focused."

The before sentence becomes false in this PR: `ImportWizard.tsx` no longer portals the tooltip out of the dialog. The after sentence is true of this head: the trap's early return is exactly "no longer reads that removal as focus lost", and the import-wizard e2e still walks every control. The three sentences before it are unchanged and still true (they describe the defect). Restoring the base text would put a false sentence into the release notes, so the red stands. Confirmed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Designed red: `Check Changeset` (`pr-automation.yml`, `pull_request` only, not on `merge_group`; the gate's source states it is red by design for this class). Lands with that red under the three conditions; the ACCEPT names the gate and the reason.
- Flake handled: `Test Core (7/8)` on the prior head (scenarios `run-date.test.ts` 5000 ms timeouts, no file of this diff in its import closure) was re-run once and passed; this head's run is green.
- `security_findings`: none.

**VERDICT: PASS**
